title: docs(skills): renaming a position tells the author to re-point their own source, names the environment owner, and restores the explain gate
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RTAWwDs8gd2Z3ErxN5LrxK)_ Fixes #33566 domain:skills#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmTSWHtysbqqYGcsTP1 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 技能 security 规则里「Renaming a position(岗位改名)」一段补三处:作者要自己改掉包源码里仍写旧岗位名的地方(共享规则接收方、审批人、队列成员、策略 `positions`、`current_user.positions` 谓词);「被另一方记录」的拒绝条件把环境(Setup 创建,`sys_metadata`)也列为所有者;明说改名搬运只改写持有人行,其他引用旧名的地方一概不改写(含 Setup 里写的)。同时把 PR #33480 删掉的运维规则补回:用 explain 查看别人的权限需要 `manage_users`、该用户所在组织的管理员身份,或覆盖该用户的委派 `adminScope`。另追加一条评测用例。 - 为什么改:原文只说「启动日志为管理员列出其他引用」,读起来像作者什么都不用做;实际上搬运从不改写包里的共享规则、审批槽位等,作者不改源码,新版本上线后这些引用仍指向已不存在的旧名。 - 风险与回滚:只动已发布技能文字、评测夹具、changeset 和 token 上限行,不动运行时与契约;先就地删重复付账,余额按实测抬棚(15834 → 15942 字节,上限 3959 → 3986 token,零余量)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:① `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 末尾「Renaming a position」段(新增句是否与 `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` 一致);② 同文件 § Assigning a permission set 的 explain 句;③ 本文件的删减处与 `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的 security.md 行。 - 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md is 3986 tokens (ceiling 3986; headroom 0)` 且以 ✓ 收尾。 - 需要你做的:无;复审 6899620269 FAIL 的修改已在新 head 上,需在新 head 上做一次 delta 复审;落地档 Tier H,见下方 Governed-surface reading。 ## What changes `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, the **Renaming a position** paragraph now reads: > **Renaming a position:** declare `renamedFrom: ['old_name']` on the renamed position, never delete and re-add (holders lose its sets). At boot its holders (`sys_user_position`) move to the new name in every organization, idempotently. Only holders: no other reference to the old name is rewritten, Setup-authored ones included. Re-point your own source naming the old one: a `type: 'position'` sharing recipient, queue member or approver, a policy's `positions`, a `current_user.positions` predicate. The boot log lists stored references by table (sharing, queue and share recipients, pending approvers, invitations) for an admin. Not carried (warned): an old name still a position anywhere, claimed twice, recorded under another owner (a package or the environment), switched off, or a disabled claimant. Card items, each re-checked against main `63db7240` first; none was already said, so all four were written: 1. The author re-points their own package source. Beyond the card's three examples (sharing recipient, approval `position:NAME` slot, RLS over `positions`), the sentence also names a queue member and a `current_user.positions` predicate, both real authoring sites (`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` § Ownership queues `members`; the placeholder table in the same file). 2. "recorded under another package" → "recorded under another owner (a package or the environment)". 3. "no other reference to the old name is rewritten, Setup-authored ones included" (the card's premise said Setup-authored bodies are carried; the code rewrites none of them). The carry does READ every position's `renamedFrom`, environment positions included, so the sentence says what is not rewritten, not what is not read (review 6899620269 M-1). 4. § Assigning a permission set to a user, after "`GET /api/v1/security/explain?object=&operation=&userId=` answers from the enforcing code path.": "Explaining another user takes `manage_users`, administering one of their organizations, or a delegated `adminScope` covering them." PR #33480 had cut "(explaining another user needs `manage_users`)"; the restored rule states the whole gate the code runs, not only `manage_users`. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: one appended case, id 21 (a package renames `sales_rep` → `crm_sales_rep` while its own sharing rule names `sales_rep`; the answer declares `renamedFrom` and re-points the rule in source). `.changeset/33566-skills-position-rename-own-source.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `rules/security.md` row 3959 → 3986 (+27), pinned at the measurement, comment `ceil(15942 / 4)`. Standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」: the cuts below were paid first (313 bytes), the measured remainder raises the row. The `tabPermissions` pointer is kept, shortened (103 → 94 bytes): "`tabPermissions` hides an app, never gates it: objectstack-ui → Who sees or opens an app." (dev open question answered B, restored: seat ruling, review S-1). Cuts, each with its surviving home: | Cut (bytes) | Surviving home | |:--|:--| | `tabPermissions` pointer shortened (−9) | the same pointer, shorter; the rule's home stays `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` § Who sees or opens an app | | Kernel-name list in the membership-keys bullet → "a fixed placeholder above, `accessible_org_ids`" | the placeholder table in the same file (`id`, `email`, `organization_id`, `org_user_ids`, `positions`, `queues`); `accessible_org_ids` kept by name as it is not in the table | | Membership-tier closed list (−73) | the docs anchor kept in the same sentence (`#membership-tiers-are-a-closed-list`) | | Second definition of `outside-closure` / `ambiguous-in-closure` in the positions bullet → "as for a queue above" (−44) | the queue bullet in the same section; the Setup-authored-set and install-refusal clauses are kept | | ", or refused below" (−19) | the next bullet: "the position grants nothing through that name" | | "Assignment is one `POST …`." merged into the next sentence (−28) | the same sentence still names the POST path | | "Declare the set on the **roster** object, not one policy per record." (−70) | the section heading ("a `current_user.KEY` set the roster object declares") and the "Choose by what the rows are keyed on" bullet | | `// in a permission set` code comment (−23) | the RLS paragraph above it ("policies on a **permission set / profile**") | Authoring tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` answers MANDATORY CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER for `skills/**` (clause ①). The card thread is served below that tier, so this diff was authored by an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER on the same branch, as the card delta orders, in both rounds (the fix round followed the seat's order on review 6899620269); the thread merged main, ran the gates and the relay. ## Tests No package source changes, so there is no package test to run. The eval case is a fixture (measured, not ratcheted) and is self-consistent: both `must_contain` strings (`renamedFrom: ['sales_rep']`, `value: 'crm_sales_rep'`) appear in its `expected_output`. `must_not_contain` is empty: the earlier `value: 'sales_rep'` occurs in the prompt, so a correct before/after answer would have failed (review S-2), and no string only a wrong answer writes was found.
Size readings, before (merge base 27c2f1ea) and after (b9479f0d) | Reading | before | after | |:--|:--|:--| | `rules/security.md` lines / bytes | 329 / 15834 | 329 / 15942 | | same file, priced tokens / ceiling | 3959 / 3959 | 3986 / 3986 | | `evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` lines / bytes / tokens (not ratcheted) | 205 / 17904 / 4476 | 215 / 19179 / 4795 | | ratcheted (authored) bundle tokens / ceiling sum | 187965 / 194113 | 187992 / 194140 | | eval fixtures tokens | 47027 | 47346 | | bundle total tokens (whole shipped tree) | 246787 | 247133 | No `SKILL.md` is touched. Main moved between the rounds by changes outside `skills/**` and the ratchet script, so the before readings equal those at the first base `63db7240`.
## Acceptance notes Each sentence was checked against the code on `63db7240`, not against the card.
Items 1 and 3: the carry rewrites holders only `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`, module doc, "What it names and never writes" (lines 78-80): ```ts * Holders only (ruling A1). Every other stored reference to an old name stays * as it is and is listed by table, so an administrator can re-point it in * Setup: sharing-rule, queue-member and record-share recipients of type ``` "What it is not" (lines 89-91): ```ts * Not a downgrade path: a version that drops the rename does not carry the * holders back. Not a metadata rewrite: Setup-authored bodies that name an * old position are not read. ``` So a package's own sharing rule, approver or policy naming the old position keeps naming it until the author changes the source; the boot log lists stored rows by table for an administrator. An environment position's own `renamedFrom` is still judged and its holders carried (`position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` lines 347-361: `{ from: 'old_rep', to: 'env_rep', packageId: null, rows: 1 }`), and the carry reads every position's `renamedFrom` ("What it does", lines 23-25). That is why the sentence says what is not rewritten rather than what is not read (review 6899620269 M-1; the first round's "no metadata is read" was wrong for exactly this case).
Item 2: the environment as recorded owner Module doc, `owned-by-other` (lines 63-65): "a row carrying the environment's sentinel (`sys_metadata`) records the environment as the owner, so a package's claim is refused and an environment position's is not." Line 173: `const OVERLAY_PROVENANCE_SENTINEL = 'sys_metadata';`, mapped at line 618: ```ts const pkg = raw === null ? null : raw === OVERLAY_PROVENANCE_SENTINEL ? ENVIRONMENT_OWNER : raw; ``` Test rows 214 and 216 refuse `owned-by-other` both ways (an environment position claiming a name the ledger records under a package; a package claiming a name the ledger records as the environment's), hence "another owner (a package or the environment)".
Item 4: the explain gate `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts`, `mayDescribeAnotherUser` (lines 145-165), asked by `explain` and by `describeEffectiveAccess` alike: ```ts if (callerContext?.isSystem === true) return true; const callerSets = await this.resolvePermissionSetsForContext(callerContext).catch(() => []); const held = this.permissionEvaluator.getSystemPermissions(callerSets); if (held.has('manage_users')) return true; const organizationLevel = this.delegatedAdminGate ? await this.delegatedAdminGate .organizationAdminCoversUser(callerSets, userId, callerContext) ``` …then `scopesCoverUser` for a delegated `adminScope`. The denial (line 196): "explaining another user's access requires the 'manage_users' capability, organization administration of an organization that user is a member of, or a delegated adminScope covering that user (ADR-0090 D6/D12)." The routes are `GET` / `POST {basePath}/security/explain` (`packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts`). The system-caller arm is left out as not an operator fact.
## Verification
Derived gates on b9479f0d (fix round 1 merged with main): 63 derived, 63 run, all exit 0 Head `b9479f0d` = fix commit `653fe698` on `169a40a0`, merged with `origin/main` `27c2f1ea` (plain merge, no conflict). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` listed 63 commands (4 paths; the ratchet script widens the set from 45). Packages built under the verify lock (`os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`, 81 of 81 tasks); each command ran with `< /dev/null`, exit recorded as `CMD :: exit N`, reconciled: ``` Run reconciliation — 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 63 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3). ``` Also run, each exit 0: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples` ("346 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)"), and the seven unmatched-roster gates the derivation flags as living in a directory this diff touches (`check-dts-references --self-test`, `check-published-list-mirrors` + `--self-test`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:published-readme-exports`). Token ratchet: all authored bundle files within their ceilings; `rules/security.md` 3986 / 3986; `--self-test` exit 0. First round (`169a40a0`): 45 derived, 45 run, all exit 0.
Governed-surface reading `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34105` on `b9479f0d`: "2 of 4 path(s) hit the register" (`skills/**` ×2; the changeset and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` are not on the register), landing tier **H**. The low-risk skills arm refuses on two counts: "a path outside skills wording and prose: scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs" and "a catalog path that names security, auth or permission". Size 84 changed lines (+60 / -24), under the 3000 human-merge threshold. The PR stays a draft until a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.
